Subject: QBR prep: runway stationing & account buckets

Team —

As we discussed on last week's leadership call, we need a compact, field-friendly QBR packet that stitches runway (probability-adjusted ARR) to account-level asks. I ran a first pass on account "buckets" and attached an XLSX with three proposed lanes:

- Green (likely to close within the quarter; primary blockers are procurement/legal)
- Amber (needs playbooks and exec engagement; 40–60% convert)
- Red (longer-term; strategic nurturing, not QBR priority)

High-level goals for this thread:
1) Validate the bucket assignments for top 25 accounts.
2) Finalize a short one-take slide per account (name, ARR, next-ask, owner, SLA risk).
3) Agree on mutual action plan (MAP) owners for two contested deals (DL-7429 and DL-7392).

Please review the attached QBR_account_buckets_20270505.xlsx for my notes and proposed owners. Key asks: mark any reassignments directly in the sheet and capture a one-line rationale.

Timebox: I'd like a consolidated packet by EOD Friday so leadership can review Monday morning. If you have objections to the buckets or want to swap owners, call it out in replies.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus — quick reads below after a first pass on the sheet.

1) ACME (DL-7429) — I agree Green but procurement timeline is tight. I suggest we move Jamie Lee to a higher touch cadence and escalate MAP ownership to me as interim exec sponsor.
2) Nimbus Analytics — currently Amber; recommend changing to Green if Karthik can confirm the technical POC is scheduled for 5/10.
3) Horizon Partners — Red; they asked for a tactical pilot next quarter, no QBR priority.

Two operational asks:
- Karthik, can you export a one-slide summary per top-10 account (PDF) by Thursday? I can take slides 1–5 and Laura takes 6–10.
- Marissa, please stitch the consolidated forecast tab and include probability-weighted ARR and committed vs. uncommitted flags.

I'll start drafting the leadership cover note once we have finalized owners.

On the MAPs, I'm fine being interim for DL-7429 but want a named AE to run day-to-day. Markus, can you confirm?

-Tessa
